name: brainstorming-tree
description: Lightweight Agent Plugin for durable, MCTS-inspired brainstorming. It persists ideas as an auditable tree so long-running agent workflows survive context loss and interference.

interface.longDescription: Moves brainstorming state out of model context into a local, auditable idea tree. Compatible agents can resume long explorations, preserve failed branches, and allocate attention with an evidence-gated MCTS-inspired loop.
defaultPrompt: 把这个问题建成创意树，并从最值得探索的分支开始
读取现有创意树，继续上次未完成的探索
审计这棵创意树，找出遗漏、死分支和最强候选
